description: The anvil.insights.v1 rolling-window document with every uninstrumented metric typed as nullable and emitted as null. v1 pins these fields as required integers, so a consumer reading it cannot tell a hardcoded placeholder from a measured zero; v3 makes the distinction machine-readable. Only witness_events_observed is instrumented today. v1 and v2 are unchanged and remain the default output, so existing consumers are unaffected. When a metric gains real instrumentation it becomes a number here and stops being nullable.
